action.body: Book RT-037 with the authorised two-person in-home crew for 2026-03-11. Customer confirms the ground-floor level access and 110 cm doorway; do not ask them to move the cabinet.

later_events.body: Specialist booking SP-037 confirmed for 2026-03-11, 13:00–16:00 UTC. Two-person crew assigned for the 54 kg cabinet with the declared access. Crew will assess the site on arrival; collection is pending.
